stations.title: Anjali
stations.say: A mug in the basket, please.

stations.title: On the shelf
stations.text: Things for sale, each with an Add button.

captions: In the gift shop, Anjali wants the till to keep a basket while she serves.
She presses Add next to the Foundry Belle mug, and the basket stays empty.
You keep the basket and the options in state, as new copies, in four tasks.
The mug goes in the basket, and a second one raises its quantity.
Same shelf, now a basket that keeps up. A line comes out as easily as it goes in.
